recommended_dose: 3 sets of 5; hold 5 s; 3-4 times/wk with a rest day between; rest 30 s between sets
how_to: Lie face down with the arms by your sides and a small towel under the forehead; lift the upper trunk just off the floor and pull the shoulder blades together, keeping the eyes on the floor; hold 5 s; lower.
modification_or_easier_version: Squeeze the shoulder blades without lifting the trunk; or do the shoulder blade squeeze standing.
safety_notes: Keep the neck long and look at the floor. Stop if it makes you dizzy or unwell [WWL]. Discomfort should ease within 2 hours of finishing; if pain lasts longer, do fewer repetitions; see a GP or physiotherapist first if you have any concerns [WWL].

exercise_name: Glute bridge with a resistance band
condition_reasons: P: lying flat on the back should be kept to a few minutes in later pregnancy [NHS]; from the 2nd trimester use a seated, standing or side-lying alternative (conservative)
recommended_dose: page gives no dose for this version (its basic bridge: 2 sets of 15 with a 3-5 s hold at the top) [Cleveland Clinic]
how_to: Lie on your back with the knees bent, the feet flat and a resistance band just above the knees; as you lift the hips into a bridge, gently press the knees outward against the band; lower slowly.
modification_or_easier_version: Basic glute bridge without the band.
safety_notes: Do not arch the back; if your back hurts, lower the hips and tighten the core [Cleveland Clinic].

exercise_name: Bent-over row with a resistance band
recommended_dose: 1 set of 12-15 reps is enough for most people [Mayo Clinic]
how_to: Stand on the middle of the band with the feet shoulder-width apart and hold both handles with the palms facing in; bend the knees comfortably and lean forward a little from the hips with the back neutral; slowly draw the elbows back close to the body, squeezing the shoulder blades together; slowly return.
modification_or_easier_version: Use a lighter band; to make it harder, move the foot closer to the handle [Mayo Clinic].
safety_notes: Keep the back neutral and the movement smooth and controlled [Mayo Clinic].

condition_reasons: P: squat only to a comfortable depth with a support within reach; K: bend the knees only within a pain-free range
recommended_dose: 1 set of 12-15 reps is enough for most people [Mayo Clinic]
how_to: Stand on the middle of the band with the feet a bit wider than shoulder-width and the knees slightly bent; hold both handles with the band midway between the shoulder and the elbow; lower slowly by bending at the hips, knees and ankles until the knees reach about 90 degrees; return to standing.
modification_or_easier_version: Go only as low as you can; do the squat without the band.
safety_notes: Keep the knees centred over the feet, not past the toes or rolling in or out; stop when tired or when your form slips [Mayo Clinic].
